problem: Off-the-shelf motors and actuators do not fit custom robot form factors, and imported components face supply and FCC restrictions, so US hardware teams wait long for custom parts.

defensibility.rationale: Well-funded rivals with a16z and Greycroft backing entered the same US motor gap in 2026. Speed and customization are the only stated edge.
